english_translation: Whether it [Genesis] is read as an allegory (and thus as Nous, the cosmic intellect encompassing all angelic intelligences), or as an anagogy (mystical union with divine intelligences), or with Kabbalistic eyes (where each day represents emanation of Sefiroth and corresponding angelic powers)...
exegesis: [PLACEHOLDER: This passage (synthesized from multiple references in Allen's treatment of Heptaplus and Commento) indicates that Pico reads Genesis through three angelological lenses: as Nous (cosmic intelligence), as mystical union with angels, and as Kabbalistic emanation with angelic correspondences. SYNTHESIZER to develop the integrated hermeneutic.]
kabbalistic_elements: **EXPLICITLY KABBALISTIC**: Each day of creation corresponds to Sefiroth and their angelic orders (Sefirah = Angelic throne/Sephirah corresponds to specific Archangel and Choir of Angels).
